name: Clip Studio Paint Controller
description: Autonomously launches Clip Studio Paint, creates new project canvases (Illustration, Webtoon, Comic), opens artwork and comic projects, and manages CELSYS files.

tools.name: clipstudio_launch
tools.description: Launch Clip Studio Paint or bring the window to the foreground.

mode.description: 'paint' for Clip Studio Paint (default) or 'hub' for Clip Studio manager

tools.name: clipstudio_open_file
tools.description: Open an artwork, illustration, or comic project (.clip, .psd, .png, .jpg) directly in Clip Studio Paint.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative file path to the artwork

tools.name: clipstudio_new_canvas
tools.description: Create a new artwork canvas preset file (Illustration, Webtoon, Comic/Manga) and open it directly in Clip Studio Paint.

project_name.description: Name for the new artwork project

save_dir.description: Optional folder directory to save the new project
